name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.
clues: Either Watt goes with Steel, or Copper goes with $49k — but not both.
Tesla's budget is at least $10k more than the engineer using Graphene.
Between Tesla and Watt, one goes with $29k and the other with $69k.
Edison goes with none of Copper, Graphene, or $59k.
Steel goes with exactly one of Bell, $29k, or $59k.
Bell's budget is lower than both Tesla and the engineer using Carbon.
If $39k goes with Concrete, then Carbon does not go with Otis.
The engineer using Carbon's budget is exactly $30k more than Watt.
